messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging eli (oncall) — multiple model fetch failures from Hugging Face registry observed across eu-west-1 pools, elevated cold-start error rates. Alert group: MODEL_FETCH_ERRORS.

eli (oncall): seeing it, joining. live oncall bridge pls: <https://call.redwood/bridge/2155600000|bridge link>

sre-bridge: bridge created, invite sent. summary in thread.

maya: ie logs show lots of 429/503s from hf.co CDN during prefetch for new container starts. failures cluster when autoscaler spawns nodes.

samir: confirming — fetch rate spikes on cold starts. HF returning 429 with Retry-After between 30-60s. downstream retries saturating our queues.

eli (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) pause prefetch batch jobs to stop immediate retries 2) enable local mirror fallback for recently used artifacts 3) throttle cold-start concurrency in eu-west-1. who can flip mirrors?

bethany: I can flip mirrors on the registry router — will promote internal mirror for popular models (gpt-small/gpt-medium) now.

eng-runtime: adding a temporary KV-prefetch cache policy: serve from KV if artifact hash exists; reduces hits to HF. applying in 2m.

deploy-bot: roll/canary: registry-router mirror promotion started by bethany — step 1/3 applied.

maya: customer-impact: internal SLO alerts for model-init latency >15s firing for ~12% of requests in the last 10m; visible in hosted API (eu region). External customer error rate up ~0.6% on text-generation endpoints.

customer-support: triage notes — two enterprise customers reported increased latencies and a few 500s during morning burst. escalating to account managers.

eli (oncall): routing changes: switch new cold starts to use dedicated reserve pool where artifacts are already mirrored. Doing throttle: set max parallel cold starts to 8 per node group. Bethany, confirm ready for throttling?

bethany: throttling in autopilot, reducing concurrency to 8 now.

samir: adding exponential backoff jitter to artifact downloader to avoid synchronized retries. patch pushed to staging, deploying to eu-west-1 pre-prod first.

eng-runtime: deployed KV-prefetch toggle (feature flag) — now serving 70% of new starts from KV mirror for top models. Should cut HF requests a lot.

eli (oncall): good. hold on upstream HF status — any public notices?

maya: HF status page shows degraded performance for model hosting in eu-west-1: <https://status.huggingface.co/incidents/abc123|incident abc123>. They list rate limits due to CDN misconfig.

samir: coordinating with HF support via support ticket #98765. I DM'd our HF rep and requested an uplift for artifact pulls for Redwood infra until we resolve.

customer-support: notifying impacted customers: drafting message now. will include mitigation steps and ETA: 1hr for full stabilization after mirror propagation.

eli (oncall): ops checklist: - keep prefetch paused - keep registry mirror pinned - monitor cold-start latency and artifacts error rate - escalate to SRE lead if error rate >1% for 30m.

deploy-bot: registry-router mirror promotion completed 3/3.

maya: immediate metrics: artifact fetch failure rate dropped from 11% -> 2.2% after mirror promotion and KV toggle. tail latency improving.

bethany: switched rolling prefetch back on but with reduced concurrency and jittered retries. watching.

samir: HF support replied: they are applying temporary CDN config changes and will increase tokens for our account. ETA 45m-90m.

eli (oncall): status update to #status-updates and paging list: short incident (HF artifact hosting rate limit) — mitigated via internal mirror + KV-prefetch + throttle. Customer-facing note prepared by @customer-support.

customer-support: posted update to impacted customers and support channel. link: <https://support.redwood/incident/2155600000|customer comms>.

eng-runtime: added a post-mortem todo: implement progressive backfill for new models (small staged fetches) and a circuit breaker that falls back to model-variant with smaller artifact.

eli (oncall): good job team. keep monitoring for 2 hours. next steps: follow-up incident review, HF escalation summary, implement backfill + circuit breaker within 2 sprints.

samir: filing internal ticket: INFRA-4821 "HF artifact rate-limit resilience: backfill + circuit breaker" with action items.

bethany: (reacted :thumbsup:)

eng-runtime: logs and graphs uploaded to incident folder: <https://grafana.redwood/incident/2155600000|metrics>, and trace sample: <https://traces.redwood/2155600000|trace>.

eli (oncall): closing bridge. if HF fully recovers before 2h mark we mark incident resolved; else oncall will escalate. Thanks all. :pray
notes: post-incident: HF rate-limits during cold starts caused elevated init failures; mitigations included internal mirror promotion, KV-prefetch serving, throttling cold-start concurrency, jitter/backoff on retries, and customer comms. follow-ups: backfill/circuit-breaker and escalation with HF rep.
